title: Measuring a course, not its items
statement: Whether measures built for questions and lessons can judge how a course sequences and builds knowledge, or a course needs measures of its own.
detail: Notes from a July 2026 meeting on the reading project record that the benchmark in use stays useful at question and lesson level, but new metrics are needed to assess lesson sequencing and knowledge building (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0125-coe-catchup-2026-07-13.qmd`). The same notes say the evaluation framework must be updated to validate the newly proposed course structure (the same file).

evidence.quote: Incept Bench remains useful at question/lesson level, but new metrics are needed to assess lesson sequencing and knowledge building
It has **no knowledge of the course's cross-lesson reinforcement plan**, so it cannot tell whether a lesson actually *compounds* on the ones before it.
